title: Craftland PC enum option-set duplication analysis
meaning: Some different enum names have an identical ordered member list in the mirror. The types may have different semantic/API roles; this analysis reduces repeated browsing only and does not declare them interchangeable. Keep all names and platform/API contexts distinct.
